notes: Anonymized trust intermediate disclosed on Charles Kushner's nominee OGE 278 (cp_filing_0005) Part 6 item 480. Holds the filer's largest block of real-estate interests (91 enumerated sub-items 480.1-480.91). Registered per the locked trust-intermediate convention: the filer's interest routes filer -> Trust 1 (trust_beneficial) -> holdings (entity_to_entity_subsidiary). Per Session 06 Fork 2, in-scope (commercial / undeveloped / operating / fund / loan-counterparty) holdings are individually registered as subsidiary nodes; ~56 residential-rental sub-items are grouped per-trust in cp_filing_0005 _excluded_categories per the locked section 3.0 inclusion test. Deeper endnote org-chart tiers (6.480.x.x) are deferred to Fork 5.
